facts.text: A search engine launched in July 2008 by former Google engineers, with massive press coverage at launch.
Claimed an index of roughly 120 billion web pages, far more than competitors publicly admitted to.
The site stumbled badly on launch day under its own traffic, and closed in September 2010, a little over two years later.
